start: A workout started on the Workout tab, two working sets ticked

user_sees: A slim bar above the tabs: 'Workout in progress', '2 sets done', the elapsed time ticking each second, an arrow
must_not: The bar on the Workout tab itself

user_sees: The workout screen opens where the member left it
must_not: A second workout screen on top of the first

start: A workout open, a set just ticked so the rest timer runs

steps.action: Go to another tab while resting
user_sees: The bar says 'Rest' with the rest countdown on the right in the accent colour
must_not: The elapsed time shown instead of the rest left
A countdown that differs from the rest timer on the workout screen

user_sees: The bar goes back to 'Workout in progress' and the elapsed time

start: Editing a saved workout (Edit workout from its page)

user_sees: The bar says 'Editing a workout' with 'Open' on the right and no sets line
must_not: An elapsed clock for an edit

start: No workout open, then a workout open

steps.action: With no workout open, look above the tabs on Profile
must_not: An empty bar with no time

steps.action: Start a workout and stay on the Workout tab
user_sees: No bar on the Workout tab
must_not: The bar shown over the open workout

steps.action: From Profile, tap the bar twice fast

start: A workout open, member on the Profile tab

steps.action: Pause the workout on the workout screen, go back to Profile
must_not: The time still counting while paused

steps.action: Resume, then come back to Profile
user_sees: 'Workout in progress'; time carries on without the paused minutes
must_not: Paused minutes added to the time
The bar left behind after the workout ended
